title: VPC Watchtower: Terraform module for centralized CloudTrail + OpenSearch lifecycle + healthchecks
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a reusable Terraform module (vpc-watchtower-logging) for Private/VPC deployments that provisions CloudTrail, grouped audit shipping, OpenSearch/ELK index lifecycle policies, S3 archival lifecycle, and a lightweight healthcheck/orchestration layer. The module should be configurable for cross-account shipping, KMS encryption, index ILM policies per log type, and safe in-place upgrades for existing customer deployments. It must integrate with Redwood Private's upgrade hooks and provide synthetic-health checks and alerting hooks for Console ingestion dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Module named 'vpc-watchtower-logging' with clear semantic versioning and upgrade notes
CloudTrail setup option: single-region or multi-region, optional CloudWatch Logs subscription
S3 bucket with enforced KMS encryption and lifecycle rules: hot->warm->cold->archive (90d, 180d, 365d, glacier) configurable
OpenSearch: index templates + ILM policies per-log-class (cloudtrail, vpcflow, app) and rollover thresholds documented
Cross-account log shipping pattern (source -> central archive account) implemented with minimal IAM privileges
Healthcheck resources: synthetic event generator, lambda-based ingestion validator, and an SNS/Monitor hook for Console alerts
Automated smoke test that verifies a CloudTrail event appears in OpenSearch within expected latency during provisioning
Upgrade path validated: patch/minor/major upgrade guidelines and migration helper scripts for index ILM changes
Terraform plan/apply idempotency on repeated runs and clear migration warnings when ILM changes are destructive
Documentation: module inputs/outputs, example root module, and runbook for incident triage
tasks: Design module interface and defaults (input variables/outputs)
Implement CloudTrail resources and optional CloudWatch Logstream
Implement S3 archive bucket with KMS and lifecycle rules
Implement OpenSearch templates, index mappings, and ILM policies
Add cross-account IAM roles and bucket policies helper
Healthcheck: implement synthetic event lambda + dashboard metrics
Create automated smoke test harness (GitHub Actions)
Write migration guide and upgrade testing harness
Add examples for Private & Dedicated deployments
Docs: Confluence runbook and README with examples
decisions: Use semantic versioning and promote terraform registry-style changelog
Default ILM policy: 30d hot, 90d warm, 180d cold, 365d archive (configurable per deployment)
Store slow-changing secrets (KMS aliases, S3 bucket ARNs) as inputs to avoid drift
Prefer resource-based policies for cross-account shipping instead of user IAM to reduce blast radius
comments: 2026-02-22 Diego Martinez: Spiked an initial prototype that wires CloudTrail -> S3 -> OpenSearch via Lambda shipper. Found edge-case where large CloudTrail files cause indexing lag; need batching and backpressure approach.
2026-02-28 Priya Patel (PM): Confirmed customer requirement for 365d cold storage and optional GLACIER tier. Asked to make ILM policy tunable via map variable.
2026-03-03 Security Review (notes): KMS envelope encryption acceptable. Must ensure least-privilege for cross-account role; add STS condition limiting external account usage to specific principals.

2026-03-05 Design feedback (Lina Gomez): Suggested synthetic healthcheck should write a named trace field to logs to make it easy to query in Console; also add a dedicated healthcheck index with short retention for SLOs.

2026-03-10 Engineering update (Ava Chen): Implemented ILM templates and a basic smoke test. Smoke test failing intermittently when OpenSearch cluster is under load; next step: add exponential backoff in indexer and expose retry config to module users.
2026-03-11 Diego Martinez: Opened PR #1482 with initial module. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1482

2026-03-12 QA note: Manual run against staging-private showed successful CloudTrail -> S3 -> OpenSearch flow with synthetic event. Need automated GitHub Actions integration before moving to In Review.
test_plan: Unit tests for Terraform module using terratest (Go) to validate plan output for default and custom variables
Integration test: provision module into ephemeral staging account, generate synthetic CloudTrail event, assert presence in OpenSearch within 90s
Chaos test: simulate throttling on OpenSearch and observe module's healthcheck retry behavior
Upgrade tests: run module v1.0 -> v1.1 -> v2.0 upgrade scenarios against a copied state to ensure ILM migrations do not drop data
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Merge module to main, tag v0.1.0 and publish internal registry
Stage 2: Enable module in 2 internal staging Private deployments and run smoke tests
Stage 3: Release v1.0.0 when tests green and security review closed
Stage 4: Offer upgrade playbook to 5 pilot customers; run in maintenance window with rollbacks if migration warnings trigger
Stage 5: Full rollout to new Private deployments and update Dedicated blueprints
